QUESTION:
What is the recommended starting dose of Prednisone?

RESPONSE:
Per the label, the initial prednisone dose varies and should be individualized — generally 5 mg to 60 mg once daily depending on the condition and severity. Lower doses are used for less severe disease; selected patients may require higher initial doses. After response, reduce in small decrements to the lowest effective maintenance dose. (Note: for acute MS exacerbations the label cites prednisolone 200 mg/day for 1 week then 80 mg every other day for 1 month; the same dosage range applies to prednisone.)
